question: Five people, A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a straight line, facing North. B is sitting to the extreme left end. Only two people are sitting between D and B. E is seated second to the right of B. A is not an immediate neighbour of E. How many people are sitting to the right of C?
solution:
Five people, A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a straight line, facing North.

 
• B is sitting to the extreme left end.
 
• Only two people are sitting between D and B.
 
• E is seated second to the right of B.
 
• A is not an immediate neighbour of E

The Final Arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/395b79ae8a71f637a1f826783532bc0576666adef919228b0f3ff3c3b4ca61ed.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
